title: Foundations of Healthy Screen Use in the Pre-School Years (4-6)
description: A path to help parents build a healthy relationship between their child and screens at a sensitive age: setting appropriate time limits, choosing safe content, making viewing a shared and interactive experience, and weaning from excess without conflict.

primary_reference.info: توصيات وقت الشاشة للأطفال — AAP + منظمة الصحة العالمية

review_defects.why: Arabic uses singular 'الشاشة' (the screen), English uses plural 'screens'. While generic, it's a slight shift.
Arabic says 'determining the appropriate time' (no mention of limits), English adds 'limits' and changes verb to 'setting'.

review_defects.english: making viewing a shared and interactive experience
review_defects.why: Arabic says 'shared and a dialogue', English uses 'interactive experience' which is broader than 'dialogue'.
